title: Yeh Sensor Haath Dekh Nahi Sakta, Phir Bhi Pakadta Hai #shorts
description:
Haath ke neeche sanitizer kyun nikalta hai? Jawab hai ek FC-51 IR sensor jo roshni ki wapsi pakadta hai, garmi nahi.
💡 IR LED aur photodiode ka kaam 3D mein
🔬 Receiver ke andar electrons kaise aazad hote hain
⚙️ LM393 comparator aur blue pot ki threshold
🔌 Arduino se wiring ka sahi tareeka
Aur aise 3D explainers ke liye subscribe karo.
#shorts #arduino #irsensor #fc51 #electronics #hindi #maker
